name: ModelVariant809_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant809_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (sparks gather around the opposing slot while the ambient light dims, and every period a burst of coloured spokes appears there and fades out until the light recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the sparks and the burst spoke tips and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 after the delay, 1 once at the end, 2 after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
